primary: Problem-equal mean time until a development-selected incumbent independently reaches 50% confirmation RMSE reduction; cap all unsolved runs at 3600 seconds. Lower is better.
secondary: Success rates by 900/1800/3600 seconds, all original final confirmation gains, full online and audit delivery elapsed time; descriptive problem-level intervals and sign flips.
selection: Root plus strictly improving development incumbents at completed batch boundaries, ties keep earlier; consider only first 3600 seconds. Never select a non-incumbent by confirmation performance.
clock: Original online/response-NNNN.json publication mtime_ns minus episode started; save stamps with source hashes, including failures, model and policy overhead. No summing worker seconds. Report shared baseline preparation and later confirmation/audit separately.
confirmation: After the original campaign closes and verifies, freeze every prefix choice before extra evaluation. Reuse original baseline and same-episode final source evaluations when byte-identical; otherwise evaluate each distinct episode/source once in original isolated executor. None for failed confirmation. No heldout feedback, retries, model calls or online stopping.
registration: Supplement registered during online exploration after partial development outcomes were seen, before any original or added confirmation. Preserve original quality protocol and disclose timing; this is not a start-of-study preregistration.
target_reason: A substantial goal fixed for this synthetic benchmark, informed by the completed prior-study mean gain near 55%; not a universal product threshold or fitted to new confirmation outcomes.
default_rule: Research efficiency has priority per latest user instruction. After both complete verified reports, use lower observed problem-equal capped mean discovery time, then higher 60-minute attainment, then original final mean gain to break exact ties; remaining ties retain control. Report uncertainty and domain limits, no partial-result promotion or automatic repo mutation.
interpretation: Discovery time is retrospectively confirmed availability of a candidate selected only by development evidence. It is not an observed online stopping time or a measured reduction in complete user-goal delivery time. Confirmation, common preparation and audit delivery latency remain separately visible. Five synthetic families and one model do not establish universal research superiority.
